floor.what: the organisers' floor: the reference's 10% working copy (copy_last or wt_identity)

fgw.what: displacement interpolation between the brackets (fused Gromov-Wasserstein coupling, proper rotation, McCann moves) with a mixture of real cells of both, scaled to the embryo size rule

fgw_shape0.what: fgw's mixture of real cells in the earlier bracket's geometry (t_pos = 0), scaled to the embryo size rule

fgw_render_hi.what: fgw's draws and positions with every cell moved to one depth: the deeper bracket thinned, the shallower topped up from kNN-smoothed profiles
fgw_render_hi.rule: depth render: every drawn cell of a bracket is moved by the bracket's ratio target / d, d = the bracket's median counts per cell over all its cells. The target is DEPTH_RULE's log-linear depth (mid), the shallower bracket's median (lo) or the deeper bracket's median (hi). A ratio below 1 thins the cell binomially, as DEPTH_RULE does. A ratio above 1 adds Poisson counts with mean (ratio - 1) x the cell's library size x the mean proportions of its 15 nearest cells of its own bracket (itself included; 30 principal components of the bracket's log1p panel expression), and adds Poisson((ratio - 1) x n) to its n counts outside the panel. A ratio of 1 leaves the rows as released

fgw_shape0_hi.what: fgw_shape0 (the earlier bracket's geometry) with every cell at the deeper bracket's depth: the shape cover of today's s2 and the depth top-up in one file
fgw_shape0_hi.rule: depth render: every drawn cell of a bracket is moved by the bracket's ratio target / d, d = the bracket's median counts per cell over all its cells. The target is DEPTH_RULE's log-linear depth (mid), the shallower bracket's median (lo) or the deeper bracket's median (hi). A ratio below 1 thins the cell binomially, as DEPTH_RULE does. A ratio above 1 adds Poisson counts with mean (ratio - 1) x the cell's library size x the mean proportions of its 15 nearest cells of its own bracket (itself included; 30 principal components of the bracket's log1p panel expression), and adds Poisson((ratio - 1) x n) to its n counts outside the panel. A ratio of 1 leaves the rows as released

fgw_series.what: fgw's draws and positions with the shallower bracket's cells moved by a per-gene factor measured on the extraembryonic cell types both brackets label alike, then to the deeper bracket's depth
fgw_series.rule: series: the shallower bracket's drawn cells are moved by a per-gene factor and then to the deeper bracket's depth (RENDER_RULE, hi). The factor is the T3 script's gene_factor over the cell-type labels that both brackets hold by name with at least SERIES_MIN_CELLS cells each and that are extraembryonic (a name starting with EXE-, or the lineage group ExtraEmbryonicMeso): the ratio of the two brackets' share-weighted mean within-cell panel proportions, weights the shallower bracket's label shares, eps 1e-5, rescaled so the weighted total proportion is unchanged, clipped to 0.25-4. It is applied in count space (binomial thinning below 1, Poisson top-up from the cell's kNN-smoothed proportions above 1). The deeper bracket's cells stay as released
